title: platanthera ophrydioides subsp. takedae
intro: Platanthera ophrydioides subsp. takedae, commonly known as the Takeda's Orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to Japan. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Platanthera ophrydioides subsp. takedae include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's efficacy and potential side effects.
